intent.description: Oracle migration delivered completely, with intact data and a rehearsed rollback.

rubrics.description: Every requested schema object, PL/SQL unit and data set is migrated and usable on the target.
criteria: Every object in the assessment inventory is migrated or explicitly descoped with a reason.
PL/SQL compiles on the target without errors.
Applications named in the request connect and run their main workflow.

rubrics.description: Migrated data matches the source, proven by row counts and checksums.
criteria: Checksums or sampled comparisons match for key tables.
The validation logs show the commands that produced the evidence.

rubrics.description: The runbook has a tested rollback with a clear trigger and point of no return.
criteria: Rollback steps are numbered, owned and timed.
The rollback trigger and the point of no return are explicit.
Rollback was rehearsed or the gap is stated.
